verdicts.why: Exposing film to light is a plain technical act with no attitude toward anything; the sentences are another sense, but the gloss is binding.
Abandoning a child in the open is a bad referent named in a plain, almost clinical word; the judgement is in the act, not the term.
To be overcome by grief or confusion states that a feeling prevailed; the gloss's 'through no fault' is descriptive of the situation, not an attitude the speaker takes toward the person.
A contract or statute that provides for a contingency is legal-descriptive language with no side taken.
Providing for a family names the act of supplying subsistence; any approval comes from valuing the act, not from the word.
Making something possible or attainable is a plain causal description without judgement.
Mounting or putting something up is a neutral physical act.
Assistance in difficulty is named plainly; the word does not grade the helper or the helped.
A pause for relaxation is a neutral description of a break from something.
A change for the better is positive by meaning, not by an attitude added beyond the meaning, as huge is large without being monstrous.
Aid for the indigent or aged is the plain administrative name for the thing, without contempt or approval.
A relief, the person who takes over a shift or post, is a role name with no judgement of the person.
Court-awarded redress is a legal term of art that takes no side.
Relief sculpture is a technical art term describing a form.
The relief of a besieged town is a plain military description of an event.
The tea plant is a botanical referent with nothing to judge.
At a short distance is a neutral measure of space.
A corset stay is a plain name for a piece of clothing hardware.
A mast stay is a nautical rigging term with no attitude.
A study as a room is a plain name for a place, like table or letter.
A branch of knowledge is named without judgement of it.
Attentive consideration describes an activity of the mind without approving or dismissing it.
A state of deep absorption (a brown study) describes a mental condition, not the speaker's view of the person in it.
A written report of findings is a neutral document type.
A technical exercise piece (an etude) is a plain musical category.
Study for a person who memorizes lines names the role; any praise in 'a quick study' is carried by the adjective, and 'slow study' exists too.
A unit of fitted components is a neutral engineering term.
A self-contained group of machine parts is a plain mechanical description.
The act of constructing or putting together is neutral process language.
Fail in the sense be unable states that something did not come off; the shortfall is its meaning, and any reproach in 'failed to mention' comes from context rather than the word.
